messages:
emma: Heads-up — several customers reporting SSO failures after last night's RBAC attribute push. SCIM 403s and SAML assertions missing group/role attributes.

devon: Any logs to paste?

emma: From scim-service:

```
2026-09-14T01:12:03Z ERROR scim_sync.go:198 decrypt envelope failed: kms:Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException tenant=prime-ads user=bob@prime.com
HTTP 403 from target provisioning endpoint
```

raj: That KMS error + 403 combo usually means envelopes were encrypted with a previous key and alias has been rotated. Did infra rotate `alias/redwood/scim`?

ci-bot: [deploy] key-rotate job `sensitive-rewrap` completed by @ops on 2026-09-14T00:59:00Z alias=alias/redwood/scim old_key=key/aa11 new_key=key/bb22

ops: Confirmed alias now points to new key. Old key still enabled but pending scheduled deletion in 10 days.

devon: Mitigation options: (A) point alias back to old key until we run rewrap; (B) run a rewrap job that reads envelopes with old key and writes with new key. Which can we do quickly?

ops: We can temporarily point alias back (requires change freeze approval) or run rewrap using existing service account if it still has decrypt rights on old key. I'll check perms.

emma: Separately SAML assertions are missing roles — sample assertion from authnproxy shows only NameID and email: no roles attribute. That causes RBAC to return no entitlements -> provisioning 403.

raj: Did the RBAC PR change attribute mapping? There was a tweak to prefer NameID email format which might have altered how we extract group attributes.

devon: Quick fix: add a fallback in authnproxy to derive roles from the `eduPersonEntitlement` or `groups` claims if `roles` absent. I'll push a hotfix to canary. Also add an alert if >2% assertions missing roles.

ops: Permission note — if we rewrap we must ensure old key grants Decrypt to the rotation job role. Old-key policy was locked down last week; I need to confirm. If not, alias rollback easiest.

emma: Customer comms — CS drafting note. Need ETA for mitigation.

ops: ETA for alias rollback ~25m after approval. Rewrap estimated 1.5-2.5h depending on envelope count.

devon: I'll land authnproxy fallback in 15m. Also will prepare backfill job to retry failed provisioning after rewrap.

raj: Postmortem items: update KMS rotation runbook to include a verification that service accounts can decrypt existing envelopes, and add a pre-rotation check that asserts no in-flight provisioning >0.

ops: Rolled alias back as temporary measure at 2026-09-14T02:05:10Z. Monitoring shows provisioning success rate rising.

emma: Verified — acme and prime-ads both started successful syncs after rollback and rewrap. Closing incident P2, will follow up with postmortem.
